en: They must buy them at the same place!
"One step forward, two steps backwards. My research is blocked again.
I am convinced that the stars can give me a solution...
But what should I do if I'm mistaken and they are the cause of the Malaise?"
The bodies are burnt to a crisp...
As if they were burnt by moonlight.
I feel different myself when the moon is red.
... Well, I always sleep really bad on those nights.
The drawings are pretty but it doesn't make sense.
Many books on... "As-tro-no-my"...
"Stellar Bod: Stars and Their Influence on the Human Body, Volume 2."
"Howling Dreams: Sleeping Better During a Full Moon, Volume 26."
"Revised Treatise on Galaxies & Their Influence on String Theory and Tears in Space-time, Volume 328."
"Constellations, Pro or Con? Volume 1"
Really nice equipment...
All copper.
With a nice finish and perfect soldering!
All this just to look at shiny dots in the sky?!
A bouquet of faded flowers placed on the grave.
"I don't care if darkness covers our island. I only care about one thing now.
...I want the Malaise to take me to you."
... Charming!
Hmm, did people really eat that?
No wonder they were all vomiting!
Hard to say whether it was left here to be eaten or destroyed.
The heat caused new life forms to take up residence in the fish.
It's revolting.
Oh lovely.
Some contaminated bodies leaked into the drainage lines... and that must have contaminated the whole water network.
But was the water contaminated before the first citizens fell ill?
"Which came first, the chicken or the egg?"
It looked solid before it was broken down.
"Keep this door locked at all costs! If the rats get out, they will spread the Malaise!"
Rats are always a prime suspect in times of illness.
I don't know, I kind of like rats.
And I'd be surprised if it was rats that made a hole like that.
"Prisoner 236"
The body doesn't look contaminated.
But how did this prisoner end up here?
Another failed escape attempt!
Some writing, but it's difficult to read.
"... Malaise... they're all... fected... not... die here"
Must be the prisoner's things.
A citizen left a message here.
"The Malaise, the Plague, the Gloom, the Green Poison... you're wasting your time putting names on this curse!
SAVE YOUR SOUL INSTEAD!"
After a while, you start to like rummaging about in other people's things.
Great way to save money.
It must have been all cozy and warm here if they were hiding weapons.
This ore does smell funny.
They mine it to enrich the King, but can this ore be the cause of the Malaise?
A letter on the desk.
Maybe this desk belonged to the guardian of this tower?

Day 1: 45 contaminated executed
Day 1: 38 contaminated 
Day 1: 42 contaminated executed
Day 1: 37
Day 1: 32...

...
Day 1: 26 contaminated executed
Day 1: 22
Day 1: 19"
Must be part of this guardian's equipment.
Ah, finally something interesting!
Unfortunately, they're a little too big for me to be able to use them.
The swords seem to be floating...
... but when I touch them, they feel solidly in place.
I really don't like this place.
That sensation again... like I'm floating, as if everything was speeding up and slowing down at the same time.
Whoa, sort makes you feel like puking, huh?
The alchemist really scattered his stuff all over the island!
... OK, so what's he on about this time?
"Time is running out... literally.
With all due respect, it can't contain the Malaise 'forever'."
An order stamped with the King's seal.
"Castaing, this is a direct order that must remain between you and me...
Stop checking the prison entrances until further notice."
All these papers are signed by Castaing.
A high-ranking prison officer, no doubt about it.
Did he set aside a few pennies for a rainy day?
In any case, the warden was prepared for combat.
Some books on a shelf.
"Prison management for dummies."
"Bridge building from antiquity to the present day."
"Managing soldiers: How to earn their respect without using torture."
"Managing prison entrances in 10 easy lessons (lesson 8 will shock you!)"
Did the prison warden have desks all over the place?
And more gold... More than the last time.
What was he up to?
A direct order from the King.
"Castaing...
When your King writes of a 'direct order that must remain between you and me', that means you mustn't post these orders on the walls for all to see!
In any case: do not allow the prisoners to leave the prison, not even when they have served their time."
I don't know much about this Castaing, but I like him already.
Several orders from the King.
"All right, Castaing, forget about the orders posted on the walls.
